name: Simei North
summary: North of Simei MRT toward Tampines / Changi — quieter east-rail living with practical hops and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Simei North is the shortlist when quieter east-rail living and Changi-side optionality matter more than Tampines mall density. The pocket sits north of Simei toward Tampines / Changi edges; housing mixes mid-age HDB, older condos, and selective landed inserts. Expats land here for EWL hops, airport-side convenience, and ActiveSG cricket-net catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: sprinkler drain-down / fire-shutter notices on mid-rises, evening Changi traffic, and confusing Simei vs Simei North shortlists. Compare with Tampines West Edge for denser new-town texture, Bedok Reservoir Fringe for park-connector living, and Tanah Merah when airport-edge calm wins.
